lastCompletedStory.title: Clean any stale recycle marker on cam run boot before spawning the watcher

nextStoryContext: US-002 adds ORCH_RECYCLE_MARKER to the run.ts import from session.ts and inserts an existsSync/unlinkSync cleanup in the result.created boot path, immediately before spawnWatcherFn is called. The cleanup is guarded by existsSync (silent no-op if absent). File-size ceilings raised: src/commands/run.ts 758->771, test/run.test.ts 870->917 (with CAM-168 tracker ref in _ref). US-003 (if it exists) can rely on the stale-marker cleanup invariant: any fresh cam run session starts with no recycle marker on disk.
